items.title: Injectivity of the restriction of the first cohomology of the structure sheaf to the inverse image of the open
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that in the vanishing situation, for a normal source over a Nagata base, the restriction map on the first cohomology of the structure sheaf to the inverse image of the open is injective (statement lines 1691-1699). The proof (proof lines 1701-1754) turns a nontrivial class into an extension and its projective bundle, uses triviality of the restriction to produce a second section, shows that it must meet the first by an affineness and finiteness argument, and finally normalizes and computes a conormal sheaf to reach a contradiction. H3: a geometric argument with several reductions, written out in full.
